pages.title: Four Points of Balance
pages.text: An uneven arrangement is invalid. Place exactly four stabilizer centers in the four directions around one shared axis, each 1–15 blocks from the controller and outside the shell.$(br2)Tiers 1–4 use one block at each point. Tiers 5–8 require a full nine-block 3×3 plane at every point.

pages.name: Advanced Stabilizer
pages.text: For tier 5 and above, surround each stabilizer's center with eight more blocks to form a complete 3×3 plane. Its flat face must point toward the Energy Core; four planes require 36 stabilizer blocks total.

pages.title: At Last, a Way In and Out
pages.text: The completed core still needed a doorway for energy. A Pylon becomes that doorway when any glass block touches one of its six faces; it then selects a nearby Core.$(br2)Sneak-use the Pylon to switch input/output, then attach the cable, machine, or Direct I/O crystal on the side your layout uses.
